title: Multi-Year Name Rate on Auto-Renewals
content:
**Rate card note: multi-year name rate on SSL/TLS Certificates auto-renewals**

The extra names of an auto-renew charge are priced at the multi-year name rate of the renewed term. The renewed term is the years of the subscription's latest term line (its latest renewal or auto-renew charge line by charge date or, where none has been billed, its purchase line).

| Renewed term | Each extra name's yearly price |
|---|---|
| three years | multiplied by the product's per-year price of a 3-year subscription divided by its 1-year price |
| two years | multiplied by the product's per-year price of a 2-year subscription divided by its 1-year price |
| one year | stays at the product's price per added name per year |

**The prices the multiplier is taken from (USD)**

| Product | 1-year price | per-year price, 2-year subscription | per-year price, 3-year subscription |
|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline DV Single Domain | 19.99 | 17.99 | 15.99 |
| Harborline DV Multi-Domain | 49.99 | 44.99 | 39.99 |
| Harborline DV Wildcard | 89.99 | 80.99 | 71.99 |
| Harborline OV Single Domain | 69.99 | 62.99 | 55.99 |
| Harborline OV Wildcard | 219.99 | 197.99 | 175.99 |
| Harborline EV Single Domain | 169.99 | 152.99 | 135.99 |
| Harborline EV Multi-Domain | 279.99 | 251.99 | 223.99 |

The multiplier is the ratio of the two prices of the subscription's own product; it is applied to each name's yearly price for every year renewed.

**Basis questions**

- *A subscription whose latest term line covers one year auto-renews. Is the name price changed?* No. On a one-year renewal each extra name stays at the product's price per added name per year.
- *Does a refunded renewal line change the renewed term?* The renewed term is the years of the latest term line by charge date, and a renewal line later refunded still sets it.

**Hypothetical illustration (price list invented for the example).** Take a product whose 1-year price were 50.00 USD and whose per-year price of a 3-year subscription were 40.00 USD, with a price per added name per year of 15.00 USD. On a three-year auto-renewal the multiplier is 40.00 divided by 50.00, that is 0.8, so each extra name's yearly price becomes 12.00 USD for each of the three years renewed.
